title: Final Period for Orbit
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the period tau in the presence of dust perturbation.

title: Final Period for Oscillations
description: Essential Criteria: The student must provide the correct expression for the period of radial oscillations tau_osc.

title: Effective Potential
description: Important Criteria: The student should derive or mention the effective potential V_eff and its significance in the problem.

title: Angular Momentum Conservation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the conservation of angular momentum in their calculations.

title: Perturbation Analysis
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly analyze the perturbation due to the dust and its effect on the orbital period.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout their calculations.

title: Common Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student may incorrectly handle signs in the equations, particularly in the perturbation terms.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student might omit necessary factors when deriving the final expressions for tau and tau_osc.
